english.title: Fly relevant UK aeroplane with max take-off mass 5,700kg or less for public transport without carrying two pilots
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of an aeroplane registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), which did not carry at least two pilots as members of its flight crew when it was flying for the purpose of public transport, had a maximum take-off mass of 5,700kg or less, was flying in circumstances where

(C)_[the pilot in command was]_
(D)_[you were]_

required to comply with the Instrument Flight Rules and had

(E)_[one or more turbine jets]_
(F)_[one or more turbine propeller engines and was provided with a means of pressurising the personnel compartments]_

english.legislation: Contrary to articles 109(1) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
were the operator or pilot in command of an aeroplane registered in the United Kingdom
which did not carry at least two pilots as members of its flight crew when it
was flying for the purpose of public transport,
had a maximum take-off mass of 5,700kg or less,
was flying in circumstances where the pilot in command was required to comply with the Instrument Flight Rules AND
had one or more turbine jets OR
had one or more turbine propeller engines and was provided with a means of pressurising the personnel compartments OR
had two or more turbine propeller engines and a maximum approved passenger seating configuration of more than nine
